items.title: Halliburton (HAL) Wins Integrated Cyprus Contract. Can Broader Services Improve Returns?
items.summary: Halliburton Company (NYSE:HAL) announced a multi-year contract from Eni S.p.A. (NYSE:E) on September 15 for the Cronos ultra-deepwater development offshore Cyprus.
